message.content:
All three deliverables are complete and verified with real shell commands.

**Team split**: I spawned one worker per independent part before doing any work — `worker_sum` (part 1) and `worker_words` (part 2). Part 3 (notes) depends on both results, so it could not be split; I did that integration myself after the workers settled. Workers reported that their instances offered only file tools (no shell), so they verified via read_file/grep; I re-verified everything end-to-end with real shell execution.

**Files written** (all under `out/`):
- `out/sum.txt` → `44`
- `out/words.txt` → `Apple/apple/fig/pear/plum` (5 lines)
- `out/notes.txt` → one line stating both results

**Commands actually run by me** (all succeeded): workspace/`out` listing; `cat -A out/sum.txt`; `awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}' data/a.txt` → 44; `python3 -c "print(sum(int(x) for x in open('data/a.txt')))"` → 44; equality check → SUM_OK; `cat -A out/words.txt`; `python3 -c "print('\n'.join(sorted(set(open('data/b.txt').read().split()))))" | diff - out/words.txt` → WORDS_OK; `wc -l < out/words.txt` → 5; `wc -l < out/notes.txt` → 1; `sha256sum` on all three.

**Results**: integer sum = 44; 5 unique case-sensitively sorted words (`Apple` before `apple`, ASCII order). No worker claimed an unrun command as run — both honestly reported the shell limitation.
